pi5-balanced.name: Pi 5 Balanced
pi5-balanced.description: 720p30 capture, 15 FPS preview, 4 Mbit/s recording. The baseline was tested on Pi 5; radio performance remains unverified.

pi3a-light.name: Pi 3 A+ Candidate
pi3a-light.description: A conservative starting point for the 512 MB board. Prepared offline; CPU, memory, drivers and encoding must be measured on the real Pi 3 A+.

offline-development.name: Offline Development
offline-development.description: 720p software test camera with QR decoding. This profile does not model sensor exposure, autofocus or ISP HDR.
